DELOITTE CONSULTING LLP received a task order from TREASURY, DEPARTMENT OF THE under GSA Alliant 2.

It is valued at up to $28,195,641.57.

The obligated amount is $12,304,842.62.

NAICS 541512 (COMPUTER SYSTEMS DESIGN SERVICES). PIID 2031ZB27F00008. Parent award PIID 47QTCK18D0029.

Competition: FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION.

The Department of the Treasury's Bureau of Engraving and Printing awarded a task order to Deloitte Consulting LLP under the GSA Alliant 2 contract vehicle on November 17, 2026. The task order, valued at approximately $12.3 million with a ceiling of $28.2 million, will run through May 20, 2027. The award was made through full and open competition. Deloitte will provide information technology management support services focused on modernizing and transforming the Bureau's manufacturing execution systems for currency production. The engagement emphasizes technology-driven improvements to enhance automation and overall management of the production process.

A contract for CLEARAVENUE LLC from General Services Administration was recently released.

It was signed on July 24, 2026.

The public record is dated November 17, 2026.

The obligated amount is $13,334,355.20.

NAICS 541519 (OTHER COMPUTER RELATED SERVICES). PIID 47QFMA26F0006. Parent award PIID 47QFMA24A0005.

Competition: FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION.

The General Services Administration's Federal Acquisition Service awarded ClearAvenue LLC a blanket purchase agreement call valued at approximately $13.3 million. The award was signed on July 24, 2026, and became public on November 17, 2026. ClearAvenue will provide computer-related services in the information technology and telecommunications sector, specifically supporting security and compliance efforts. The work runs from August 27, 2026, through August 26, 2027, under the DEHRADS cybersecurity, privacy, records management, and environments support program. The award was made through full and open competition and falls under the other computer-related services classification.

A contract for NCS TECHNOLOGIES INC from Social Security Administration was recently released.

It was signed on September 30, 2026.

The public record is dated November 17, 2026.

The obligated amount is $10,674,042.61.

NAICS 334111 (ELECTRONIC COMPUTER MANUFACTURING). PIID 28321326FA0010230. Parent award PIID 28321326A00040001.

Competition: FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION.

The Social Security Administration awarded NCS Technologies Inc. a blanket purchase agreement call valued at approximately $10.7 million. The award, signed on September 30, 2026, and released publicly on November 17, 2026, covers the distribution of roughly 6,000 laptops to direct service components that support public-facing operations. The equipment refresh will support disability adjudication functions across the agency. The work involves information technology hardware and end-user support services, with the award made through full and open competition. The performance period runs from September 30 through October 30, 2026.
